Every Joern population in this benchmark selects its endpoints through the adapter's own query parameters, which the tool-native activation rule forbids. Fresh v0.9.2 Amendment A26 evidence for Joern 4.0.660 records 58 bundled queries tagged C=27, Android=10, PHP=9, Java=7, Kotlin=3, and Ghidra=2; none is tagged JavaScript or Python. All 36 positive/near-miss invocations exited successfully and imported their CPGs, but every retained report has `scan_pass_completed: false`, so its empty result set cannot be interpreted as a completed clean scan. The Java `call-to-exec` binding probe also found that the query's full-name pattern `java.lang.Runtime.exec` matches zero methods, while a structural lookup found one method named `exec` and one call with full name `List(java.lang.Runtime.exec:java.lang.Process(java.lang.String))`. These results leave the native cell unsupported; they do not establish that a completed scan would produce no finding.
